description: This file contains various platform-specific functions and upgrade logic for embedded devices, including functions for manipulating UBI volumes, toggling root filesystem partitions, reading boot configurations, and performing firmware upgrades tailored for different device models.

methods.name: remove_oem_ubi_volume
methods.description: Removes a named OEM UBI volume if it exists by finding the UBI device and volume, then executing the ubirmvol command.

methods.name: qihoo_bootconfig_toggle_rootfs
methods.description: Toggles the primaryboot configuration of a specified MTD partition by copying, modifying, and rewriting the partition data.

methods.name: tplink_get_boot_part
methods.description: Determines the current boot partition by reading kernel command line arguments or U-boot environment variables.

methods.name: tplink_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs an upgrade process and switches boot partitions based on current configuration.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Stub function to check the image; returns success.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main function that performs device-specific upgrade procedures based on device model, including UBI volume manipulations and environment settings.
